basis: FAM-BLAZER-FLAVOR-003: install-artifact contract for the Pixel 10 Pro flavor, from checked-in pinned fixtures only. Values marked 'from' are cross-checked by scripts/factory-package.py against the named source on every load; nothing here is evidence that a blazer artifact was built, signed, installed or accepted on a phone.

device.from: os/devices/pixel10.json devices.blazer (lunch probe notExecuted) and adevtool vendor-skels firmware/android-info.txt (require board=)

provenance.vendorInputs: os/devices/pixel10.json devices.blazer.vendorInputs: factory image blazer-cp3a.261005.005-factory-cd7d12c2.zip is an adevtool build-index value only (status indexed); this repository never downloaded or verified it

firmware.from: os/devices/pixel10.json shared.firmware, equal to the pinned adevtool android-info.txt

ota.producer: generate-release.sh ota_from_target_files, run by scripts/host-sign.py, which truncates the script before img_from_target_files
ota.applicability: In-place update only: a phone already running a build of this device whose recovery/update_engine trusts the same OTA certificate (metadata pre-device must equal the device). Never a first install, and never decomposed into partition images for fastboot.

factory.signature: {device}-install-{build}.zip.sig (ssh-keygen -Y sign -n "factory images", only when the key directory holds id_ed25519)
factory.producer: generate-release.sh after the OTA: img_from_target_files -> device/common/generate-factory-images-common.sh -> fastboot -S 0x10000000 optimize-factory-image (MAX_DOWNLOAD_SIZE for rango|mustang|blazer|frankel)
factory.currentlyProducedBasis: No RoseOS job builds blazer, and no job runs the factory stage: host-sign.py derive_release_script cuts at the one '\nimg_from_target_files' anchor (OTA only).
factory.membersBasis: Layout of a GrapheneOS-script install archive as checked by the historical os/reference-scripts/verify-factory-mustang.py (same release script family, Pixel 10 Pro XL); historical structure evidence, not a blazer observation.

inventory.source: the signed target-files the factory archive was generated from (never this file, never a guessed list)
inventory.images: IMAGES/{partition}.img: every A/B partition outside dynamic_partition_list that has one must appear byte-equal as {partition}.img
inventory.firmware: RADIO/bootloader.img and RADIO/radio.img must equal the factory bootloader-/radio- images. An A/B partition without an IMAGES/ entry counts as firmware-carried only when a roseos.factory-firmware-observation.v1 bound to those two image digests lists it; absence alone never qualifies
inventory.dynamic: dynamic_partition_list partitions: super_1..N.img rebuilt with simg2img and unpacked with lpunpack from the hash-pinned otatools archive (as the historical verify-factory-mustang.py did), the unpacked set and each logical image byte-equal to target-files IMAGES/{partition}.img (flattened with simg2img when sparse); _b outputs must be empty
inventory.layoutBasis: The RADIO/ and IMAGES/ layout is AOSP releasetools convention; no blazer target-files listing is in this repository. A missing entry refuses, it never passes.
inventory.observation: roseos.target-files-observation.v1 from `factory-package.py observe`: target-files sha256 and the names of META/ IMAGES/ RADIO/ OTA/ members, delivered by release through its normal receipt path
inventory.observedBasis: No blazer target-files has been built or signed; synthetic test observations are never listed here.

generatorFixture.basis: os/pinned-manifest.xml device_common; generate-release.sh sources both. The install-archive member names here follow the historical mustang layout until these are reviewed fixtures

historicalObservations.source: original Infra authorized historical artifact inspection (Pro run diagnostic; no artifact reread or raw logs in this repository)
doesNotEstablish: a generated vendor tree or lunch result

installSemantics.abUpdateBasis: required to read ab_update=true from META/misc_info.txt; the archive flashes slot a and both bootloader slots per the historical install layout
installSemantics.dynamicPartitions: read from misc_info dynamic_partition_list per artifact
installSemantics.virtualAb: recorded from misc_info virtual_ab per artifact; OTA_ARGS=--disable_ublk for these devices in generate-release.sh
installSemantics.rollback: Not claimed. No blazer artifact exists; downgrade and anti-rollback behaviour are unmeasured.
installSemantics.relock: Bootloader relock eligibility needs avb_pkmd.bin equal to the flavor's AVB public key AND physical acceptance; the classifier checks only the first and never claims relock is safe.

identity.avbPublicKeySha256From: none: no blazer signing identity, published blazer release or first-use record exists; avb_pkmd.bin can never match, so every factory candidate refuses
identity.otaCertificateSha256From: none: no blazer OTA certificate exists
identity.mustDifferFrom: frankel and rango identities (a blazer pin equal to either is a signer collision)
identity.signingKeys: none provisioned (signing owner; Chief decision for any new identity)

readiness.basis: No blazer build, signing, publication or phone receipt exists. Only a real receipt delivered through its owner's normal path may change this; synthetic test evidence never does.

missingForFactory.input: build-only recipe preparation stages (os/build-only/blazer.json via scripts/blazer-build-only.py download, vendor, lunch): not executed
missingForFactory.next: on an admitted builder, in an isolated work tree (never the production source root): download and verify the pinned factory image, generate vendor/google_devices/blazer (product registration, firmware metadata), then the lunch target check; the historical Pro run 41255851279 observed only configuration and pins

missingForFactory.input: operator review of the recipe's proposal preparation bounds (preparation.download/vendor/lunch boundBytes and timeoutSeconds) and the host Node version; compile's measured compileAllowanceBytes is still null
missingForFactory.next: Infra/operator accepts or replaces the proposal bounds before any runtime approval; the stages measure and record what they consume. No new gate here
download and verify against the pinned sha256 on the builder (absent in historical Pro run 41255851279); never in this repository

missingForFactory.input: blazer signing identity (OTA certificate and AVB key)
missingForFactory.next: provision a distinct blazer identity; pin its published avb_pkmd.bin sha256 here only from a completed authorized publication receipt

missingForFactory.input: factory stage of generate-release.sh for a blazer build
missingForFactory.next: same opt-in tail as frankel/rango once a signed blazer target-files exists

missingForFactory.input: factory-signing identity (principal + ssh-ed25519 public key, namespace "factory images")
missingForFactory.next: decide whether RoseOS signs install archives; if so, pin its public half in factorySigning

missingForFactory.input: names-only observation of a signed blazer target-files
missingForFactory.next: run `factory-package.py observe` on the first admitted signed blazer output; list the receipt in inventory.observed

missingForFactory.input: firmware observation of bootloader/radio carried partitions
missingForFactory.next: emit roseos.factory-firmware-observation.v1 alongside the install archive

missingForFactory.input: pinned generator and optimizer layout in this contract (artifacts.factory.generatorMembers/optimizeMembers, inventory.generatorFixture/optimizeFixture)
missingForFactory.next: adopt the device_common 1f5ba267 and platform_system_core 322ff512 fixtures as frankel/rango do; until then classify reports `contract:blazer pinned generator layout` and no blazer archive can complete

missingForFactory.input: physical first-install acceptance on a Pixel 10 Pro
missingForFactory.owner: QA with an explicit device handback
missingForFactory.next: only after a classifier-ready archive exists

factorySigning.owner: signing (Chief approval for any new identity)
factorySigning.basis: generate-release.sh signs {device}-install-{build}.zip with ssh-keygen -Y sign -n "factory images" -f $KEY_DIR/id_ed25519 only when that key exists; os/signing-bootstrap/profiles.json: id_ed25519 is optional and not produced by generate-keys. No RoseOS factory-signing public key exists in approved inventory, so signatureVerified cannot pass. Never generated here and never derived from OTA/AVB keys.
factorySigning.verifier: ssh-keygen -Y verify -f <allowed_signers from this pin only> -I principal -n "factory images" -s ARCHIVE.sig

buildRoute.basis: References only: those files own the build-only recipe, Rose integration admission and the approved Updater route; nothing is duplicated here.
